    An Adjustment records a credit or debit that Stripe makes to your Financial Account balance, for example to correct technical or operational errors.

    A FinancialAccount represents a balance and can be the source or destination of money movement.

    The FinancialAccount's balance, split into available, inbound_pending, and outbound_pending balances.

    If the FinancialAccount's type is other, this hash identifies its actual type.

    If the FinancialAccount's type is storage, this hash contains details specific to that type.

    InboundTransfer
    An InboundTransfer object, representing a money movement from a user owned PaymentMethod to a FinancialAccount belonging to the same user.

    The bank account credential used to fund the InboundTransfer (for example, a US bank account), not a Payments API pm_ PaymentMethod.

    For more details about TransferHistory, please refer to the API Reference.

    The InboundTransfer was submitted to the scheme for processing.

    InboundTransfer.TransferHistory.BankDebitReturned

    InboundTransfer.TransferHistory.BankDebitSucceeded
